description: How much of the property's traffic Search Console hides from the query/page rows because of anonymization: exact totals per day (no dimensions) minus the sum of the query × page rows = hidden clicks/impressions, with hiddenShare (fraction), level (ok < 5 %, warn 5–15 %, high > 15 %), the worst day and an optional daily table. Only searchType applies (dimension filters do not make sense here). Use to explain why top-queries totals do not add up to the summary, and before trusting query-level shares on small sites. / Cliques escondidos pela anonimização do Search Console.

days.description: Window length in days (default 28). Ignored when startDate and endDate are both given. / Janela em dias.

endDate.description: End yyyy-mm-dd. Default: last synced date of the property (Search Console lags ~3 days; never "today"). Every response states the period used. / Fim; padrão = última data sincronizada.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id.

name: analyze_sampling_impact
title: Hidden (anonymized) clicks
